summary: Iteration 17 — Stage-1 punch list fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 new tests PASS (Review folder add/list/approve/reject + setup recovery_email/trusted_numbers + Repeated wrong access codes event + verify-access). Frontend: (a) Fresh-device wizard ends on data-testid='setup-complete' with text 'Digital Mate is now protecting your phone.' and setup-complete-btn → cover-calculator → 2580= → dashboard (tile-vault visible). (b) Protection Status shows check-contact GREEN (emerald) when recovery_email is set during setup. (c) On a configured device, entering 9999= 5x on the cover silently switches to data-testid='decoy-mode' (no unlock occurs first — decoy gate is correctly placed before cover gate); /api/security/events records 'Repeated wrong access codes'. (d) Tapping the status-bar time 5x opens decoy-exit-modal; entering 2580 on decoy-exit-input + decoy-exit-confirm fully unlocks to the real dashboard. (e) Vault screen folder toggle folder-vault/folder-review works; seeded review item appears under Review with review-approve/review-reject; Approve moves it to Vault tab (toast 'Approved — moved to vault'). No JS errors observed during the flows.
critical_code_review_comments: SetupWizard.js: completion screen branches on `done` and lives inside the same component — clean. setup-contact accepts either an email (forwarded as recovery_email) or anything else (forwarded as trusted_numbers[0]) — good UX; no client-side email validation, but backend already accepts both and SecurityChecklist's check-contact correctly OKs either via `status.has_email || status.trusted_numbers.length`.

App.js: failCountRef increments on every non-recovery, non-access submission; the threshold of 5 resets the counter and sets forceDecoy=true. The decoy gate `(forceDecoy || (unlocked && trapLevel >= 2)) && !decoySuppressed` now PRECEDES the cover gate, so the decoy is shown without ever unlocking — matches the spec. decoy-exit-confirm sets unlocked=true + role + clears forceDecoy + sets decoySuppressed=true + clears decoyExit — fully drops to dashboard. ✓

App.js: failCountRef is a useRef on App, which is fine for a single mounted component, but it does NOT persist across reloads. Acceptable trade-off (resets after browser restart), but worth noting if Stage-2 wants persistent counters.
security_engine.py /vault/list with status=vault uses an $or that ALSO includes documents with no status field — good backward compat for items created before the field was added.
security_engine.py /vault/approve does NOT verify ownership beyond device_id match — same trust model as the rest of the vault endpoints (device-id-scoped). Consistent with existing design.
VaultScreen.js: when folder=='review' there is correctly NO 'Hide something' button; review items each render approve/reject buttons; rejecting calls vault/item DELETE. ✓
SecurityChecklist.js: check-contact uses `status?.has_email || (status?.trusted_numbers || []).length` — green tick if EITHER email or trusted number is set. ✓
test_credentials: Setup via /api/security/setup access_code=2580, recovery_code=rec22, recovery_email=me@test.com. Cover unlock = 2,5,8,0,=. Decoy exit access code = 2580.
